tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The quoted price should include minimum wages and service charges
The quoted prices must be Exclusive of GST.
Three Packages are created in tender. for each package, tender will be awarded to L1 tenderer/Bidder.
Should satisfy the all conditions of the tender documents.

itemList.itemName: Providing Man Power to KMFDDL (Quote service charge in percentage, Exlusive of GST)
Transferring 25 kg SMP/WMP bags from Bulk filling to Powder Godowns and stacking batchwise and keep godown clean. (Quote Per Bag excluding GST)
Production and Packing of Shrikhand in 100 gm, 250gm and 500 gms Cups. (Quote Per Kg excluding GST)
Production and packing of sterilized flavoured milk in 200 ml bottles. (Quote Per bottle excluding GST)
Production and Packing of Mysore Pak in 100 & 250 gm PP Boxes (Quote Per Kg excluding GST)
Production and packing of Badam Milk Mix, Jamoon Mix and Milk Millet Malt Mix in 200 gm standy pouches. (Quote Per Kg excluding GST)
Production and Packing of Ladagi Laadu in 200 gm Master Cartons (Quote Per Kg excluding GST)

During SMP/WMP production preparation of 25 kg KP bags with Liners, writing batch No. on the bags, filling 25 kg powder, tying another cotton tape, stiching the bags and stacking bags in the room. (During CIP of the plant, the persons on the duty for packing should attend to the works entrusted by operators/shift officer/head(Prodn) (Quote Per Bag excluding GST)
Production and Packing of Khoa in 5 kgs (Quote Per Kg excluding GST)
Production and Packing of Karadantu in 250 gm Master Cartons (Quote Per Kg excluding GST)
Production and Packing of Jaggery Peda in 200 gm Master Cartons (Quote Per Kg excluding GST)
Production and Packing of Dharwad Peda in 250 and 100 gm Master Cartons (Quote Per Kg excluding GST)
Breaking of coal to 2 inch sizes and transferring to Boiler House and make heaps of coal dust. (Quote Per MT excluding GST)
Re-stacking of 25 kg butter cortoons in deep freezes batchwise (Quote Per Box excluding GST)

To bring 25 kg bulk bags from milk storage godown to retail packing room and to pack in 500gm packate under KBS by using milk powder packing machine given by KMFDDL. After packing, required to shift to godown No.3 and stack batcwise. (Quote per 500gm packet excluding GST)

To bring 25 kg bulk bags from milk storage godown to retail packing room and to pack in 1 kg packate under KBS by using milk powder packing machine given by KMFDDL. After packing, required to shift to godown No.3 and stack batchwise. (Quote per 1 kg packet excluding GST)
